item.title: LOT-089: new topic composer
item.body:
LOT-089
Closes #181
Claim: cloud/lot-089

**Problem.** A member cannot start a topic from the app (legacy: "+" button of a forum list, `MainWindow.swift:745-757` @ 2440d79).

**Cause.** The engine write exists (LOT-048 `PostingFlow.newTopic`) but no screen reaches it.

**What changed, and why this wide and no wider.** Spec `docs/lots/LOT-089-new-topic-composer.md`. The reply/MP composer is reused (`ComposerTarget.newTopic`, same draft, close and error machinery); the write path is untouched. LOT-085 (#458) is merged in.
- `NewTopicTarget` (list's `md_btn_new_topic` + page `categoryID`), `ReplyPosting.newTopicOptions` / `newTopic`, `NewTopicSubcategories` (picker state, form preselection honoured; Send waits for the read).
- Subject field and sub-category menu in `ReplyComposerView`; draft `.newTopic(forum:)` keeps subject and text.
- `TopicListView`: "Nouveau sujet" toolbar button for a current account; `TopicListModel.newTopicDidClose` shows HFR's sentence and reloads page 1.
- The created topic is not opened: HFR's answer names none (`W40`: refresh to the category list).
- Changelog line 61 in `docs/CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md`.

**Tests** (`NewTopicComposerTests`, `TopicListNewTopicTests`): target rules, options and preselection, choice sent, failed read still sendable, `unknownSubcategory` re-read, confirmed/unconfirmed, non-BMP subject refused, draft per forum, list entry and page-1 reload. Not run locally (the app builds on CI); SwiftLint clean locally; `HFRKit` unchanged. Known gap: no test asserts "no Send while the picker loads" (needs a gated double).

Adversarial review (Opus): round 1 REQUEST CHANGES, round 2 REQUEST CHANGES, round 3 APPROVE on `0fcb499`; its Low notes were then applied, and the #458 merge conflict in `ReplyComposerView.swift` was resolved after that APPROVE.

## Mac check needed (for `mac/m2-lead`)
- [ ] "Nouveau sujet" appears in a forum's list toolbar when logged in, not logged out, not on Favoris/Drapeaux, iPhone and iPad.
- [ ] Sheet: subject, sub-category menu (16 options, "Aucune" first, none preselected on R45a), text, with the LOT-085 toolbar; light, dark, Dynamic Type XL.
- [ ] Real send in a test forum: HFR's sentence in the banner, page 1 reloaded, the topic is there (also from a sub-category list: its `message.php` form is pending capture, R06).
- [ ] Failure paths: offline at open (warning + Réessayer, still sendable), flood refusal sentence, 70+ character subject message.
- [ ] Draft: kept per forum across close/relaunch, discarded after send; swipe-down blocked with text.
- [ ] Mutation runs of the new tests (LESSONS 54: full Swift Testing names).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_014QH2CGxTd2Dk1CazTGStAK

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Create new forum topics directly from eligible topic lists, with a subject field and subcategory picker.
  * Topic drafts are retained per forum and account. Subcategory options can be retried if loading fails.
  * After submission, the topic list refreshes and shows confirmation when the topic is confirmed as sent.
* **Bug Fixes**
  * Uncertain submissions are not automatically resent; guidance helps users check the topic list before trying again.
* **Documentation**
  * Added a specification and changelog entry for new-topic composition.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

Walkthrough

The shared composer now supports creating new forum topics. Eligible topic lists expose the composer. The flow loads subcategory options, validates and submits the topic, stores drafts, and refreshes the list after relevant close outcomes. **Changes: New-topic composer** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Target and posting contract**
`App/SwiftHFR/Composer/ReplyPosting.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Composer/ComposerMessages.swift`|The composer target and posting interface support new-topic options and submission. Messages distinguish topic-specific form errors and unconfirmed submissions.| |**Composer state and submission**
`App/SwiftHFR/Composer/NewTopicSubcategories.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Composer/ReplyComposerModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Composer/ReplyComposerRules.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Composer/*`, `docs/lots/LOT-089-new-topic-composer.md`, `docs/CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md`|The model loads and selects offered subcategories, validates topic subjects and text, submits topic details, and persists forum-scoped drafts. Tests and documentation describe these behaviors.| |**Composer interface**
`App/SwiftHFR/Composer/ReplyComposerView.swift`|The view shows topic subject and subcategory controls, loading and retry states, and topic-specific titles and draft guidance.| |**Topic-list integration and outcomes**
`App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/TopicListModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/TopicListView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Root/RootSidebarView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Root/RootTabsView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/TopicListModelTests.swift`|Topic lists expose the composer when the target and composer service are available. After sending or checking a topic, the model reloads page 1; confirmed sends also display a dismissible confirmation.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant TopicListView participant TopicListModel participant ReplyComposerModel participant LiveReplyPoster participant PostingFlow TopicListView->>TopicListModel: Read newTopicTarget TopicListView->>ReplyComposerModel: Present new-topic composer ReplyComposerModel->>LiveReplyPoster: Request subcategory options LiveReplyPoster->>PostingFlow: Load topic form ReplyComposerModel->>LiveReplyPoster: Submit topic details LiveReplyPoster->>PostingFlow: Submit new topic ReplyComposerModel->>TopicListModel: Report composer close reason TopicListModel->>TopicListModel: Reload page 1 after send or check-topic ``` **Possibly related issues** - [ezzz/HFRnow#192](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/192) — The change stores forum-scoped new-topic drafts, while this issue requests listing and reopening those drafts as follow-up behavior. - [ezzz/HFRnow#191](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/191) — The issue extends the new-topic form with poll fields. - [ezzz/HFRnow#129](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/129) — The change adds the captured new-topic subcategory picker and preserves form preselection. **Possibly related PRs** - [ezzz/HFRnow#398](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/398) — This change extends the private-message composer and shared `ComposerTarget` with new-topic behavior. - [ezzz/HFRnow#294](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/294) — This change builds on the reply composer, posting interface, and draft behavior introduced there. - [ezzz/HFRnow#408](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/408) — This change submits public new topics through the confirmation and refresh contracts introduced there.
Merge Risk: Moderate · up to daa0f

A retry may post in an unintended subcategory, and checking a submission may show the wrong list. Resolve these risks before merging.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to daa0f

The new flow reuses existing account-scoped posting safeguards and does not demonstrate a material security regression. Topic creation remains an authenticated action, with explicit handling of uncertain outcomes rather than automatic resubmission. Incomplete coverage leaves some residual uncertainty. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The new security-relevant exposure is authenticated topic creation through the app, affecting forum content under the captured account and that account’s forum-scoped drafts. The inspected path does not introduce cross-origin posting authority or a new service identity; server-side permission enforcement was not independently audited. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — The page-derived target link is restricted to the HTTPS forum host and default port. PostingFlow independently checks the requested and final form URLs and the submission action URL. POST redirects are not followed, and session identity must match the identity captured during form loading. - _observed_ — Submission requires a new-topic form, validates subject and text, and rejects an explicit subcategory not offered by the freshly loaded form. The shared submission path also clears the delete checkbox for non-delete operations, limiting unintended destructive behavior from form defaults. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — Concurrent sends are gated before the first suspension, and interactive dismissal is blocked during a send. These controls contain overlapping write attempts within a composer instance; they do not provide server-side idempotency for deliberate later submissions.

**Explanation** The title "LOT-089: new topic composer" matches the main change. The PR adds a new-topic flow that reuses the reply/MP composer, with a subject field, a sub-category picker, per-forum drafts, and a Nouveau sujet entry point in the topic list. The title names the ticket and the primary feature. It does not describe the response-display or page-1 reload behavior, which is expected for a short title.

**Explanation** The changed implementation, tests, LOT-089 specification, root composer wiring, and legacy changelog support [`#181`]. The shared composer-rule refactor supports the new-topic flow. No unrelated product behavior or new dependency is shown.

**Explanation** [`#181`] requires opening the new topic after a successful send. `TopicListModel.newTopicDidClose(.sent)` stores HFR's confirmation and reloads page 1; it does not navigate to the created topic. `TopicListNewTopicTests` verifies reload and confirmation, not topic opening. The implementation covers the toolbar entry, composer fields, sub-category preselection, drafts, send flow, and Swift Testing models. The issue remains open with the open-on-success criterion. The current evidence does not show an approved change to that criterion. **Resolution** Provide a sourced HFR response that identifies the created topic and implement navigation to it, with a test for successful navigation. If HFR cannot identify the topic, update `#181` to replace the open-on-success criterion with the reload behavior before closing the issue.
